home.name: Vicky
home.tagline: I'm looking for my next team!
home.description: I'm Vicky, a Senior Software Developer based in Berlin. I specialise in React and TypeScript — building interfaces that are fast, clean, and actually enjoyable to use. I've shipped products across e-commerce, proptech, and developer tooling, and I work best when design, backend, and product are all in the same room. These days I'm also deep into AI-assisted development — using it to move faster without losing quality.

aboutText.0: 10 years in, and the part I still enjoy most is the moment something clicks — when a feature feels right, the code is clean, and the team is proud of what shipped.
aboutText.1: I've worked across startups and scaleups in Berlin and beyond — HeyCar, Myntra, Aliru, Purpose Green. Frontend is home, but I'm comfortable enough across the stack to understand the full picture and have the right conversations.
aboutText.2: Lately I've gone deep on AI-assisted development. Claude Code in the terminal, agents in the codebase, LLMs as a thinking partner. It's changed how I work — I ship faster, think more clearly, and hold a higher bar.
aboutText.3: I'm currently open to new opportunities — Senior Software Developer or a lead-flavoured role, in Berlin or remote.

about.title: About
about.description: About Vicky — experience, skills, and background
about.intro: 10 years in, and the part I still enjoy most is the moment something clicks — when a feature feels right, the code is clean, and the team is proud of what shipped. I've worked across startups and scaleups in Berlin and beyond. Frontend is home, but I'm comfortable enough across the stack to understand the full picture and have the right conversations.

0.summary: Led the frontend team that built Green+ from scratch, a portal for property investors covering energy analysis of around 3 million m² of building space. Owned onboarding, Stripe subscriptions and the frontend-backend contract, set up the monorepo and design system, and helped shape the team's Claude Code workflow.

1.summary: Owned the Dutch market end to end on a used-car marketplace running in 5 markets, including a Core Web Vitals push. Led a design system upgrade used across all markets and cut the tech debt backlog by 50%.

2.summary: Built a Salesforce CRM versioning product from concept to delivery, often as the sole engineer, on €135k of pre-seed funding over 16 months. Worked directly with the founder and built the core VSCode extension, Node.js APIs and a React Native companion app.

3.summary: Built a low-code chatbot admin platform from scratch as an early engineer. Designed a visual flow-graph editor that removed three steps from bot building and cut build time by about 50%.

4.summary: Built a web platform for Mathematica Policy Research that replaced raw API calls, so researchers could manage projects through a usable interface. Led two interns.

5.summary: Built production web apps: data-driven dashboards, management interfaces, sign-up flows, landing pages and an interactive product demo.
